vignette.story: John is a proud parent who enjoys sharing updates about his family's life on social media. The visitors on his Facebook page, which he affectionately calls "The Smith Family Chronicles," include friends, family, and acquaintances from various parts of his life. John is excited to post about the upcoming school year and activities his children, Lily and Alex, will be involved in. He checked his personal calendar, aptly named "Smith Scheduler," and found the detailed school schedules for Lily and Alex, including drop-off and pick-up times, as well as the locations of their after-school activities at the "Bright Minds Learning Center" and "Junior Athletes Club" respectively. He also found photos from a recent family vacation to "Sunny Shores Beach Resort" and a funny anecdote about his youngest child Alex's first attempt at baking cookies, which he thought would be perfect to share on "The Smith Family Chronicles."
vignette.data_type_concrete: The detailed school schedules for his children, including drop-off and pick-up times, as well as the locations of their after-school activities.
